messages:
lina: Heads up — since ~09:12 UTC we're seeing a burst of client 5xxs (mostly 502/504) for hosted inference in us-east-1. Customers report timeouts; traces show requests queued behind a long scale-up. sample req: req_0a1b2c id: 8f3c...

kevin: Saw alert spam from proxy: `upstream_read_timeout` and gateway 502s. Any k8s events around 09:10-09:14?

maria: Past 30m of `kubectl get events --all-namespaces` (trimmed):
```
09:09 kubelet node1 Preempted ephemeral Spot instance (terminated)
09:10 pod/model-server-xx Readiness probe failed: context deadline exceeded
09:11 HPA scaled up from 0->3 pods
09:11 KEDA scaledobject triggered scale up but pods stayed Pending
09:12 pod/model-server-xx ImagePullBackOff (backoff)
```

kevin: Interesting — HPA/KEDA both signaled but pods remained Pending. Can someone paste `kubectl describe pod` for one of the Pending pods?

raj: grabbing logs, but early hint: cloud provider had a preemptive eviction window 09:08-09:10 due to capacity; nodes were replaced. New nodes come up but taints/labels applied by startup automation delayed scheduling (~60s). Also seeing kube-scheduler messages about leader election/lease jitter.

lina: I pulled `kubectl describe pod model-server-xx` — Events show: `0/8 nodes are available: 2 node(s) had taints that the pod didn't tolerate, 4 Insufficient cpu`. Then `PodScheduled` -> `FailedAttachVolume` for ephemeral cache volume, then `BackOff` for initContainer.

kevin: Copy of the KEDA ScaledObject config for the tenant (redacted):
```
apiVersion: keda.sh/v1alpha1
kind: ScaledObject
metadata:
  name: tenant-abc-scaledobj
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    name: model-deployment
  minReplicaCount: 0
  maxReplicaCount: 10
  triggers:
  - type: rabbitmq
    metadata:
      queueName: tenant-abc-queue
```

kevin: Note minReplicaCount: 0 — combined with spot preemption we get cold starts when traffic spikes. Also our podPreemptionPolicy and node affinity can cause scheduling to wait while the autoscaler tries to converge.

maria: Repro notes from support: Customer ran a 200rps test starting 09:10. Most requests within first 30s failed (502). If we prewarm to 1 replica, failures go away.

raj: Found additional root cause: our startup initContainer pulls a ~600MB model artifact from S3 serially; when nodes restart during eviction storms multiple pods try to pull concurrently and hit S3 throttling -> ImagePull/BackOff and delayed readiness. Combined with KEDA min 0 -> long tail.

lina: Quick mitigations proposed: 1) set minReplicaCount:1 for high-traffic tenants, 2) add prewarming flag in tenant config to keep a warm pod during business hours, 3) change initContainer to use sidecar warm cache + binary delta pulls or switch to smaller bootstrap weights.

kevin: Short term patch: apply KEDA patch for tenant-abc to minReplicaCount:1 and change pod annotation `preemptible=false` for model-server to avoid spot eviction. Also add a transient admission hook that sets tolerations only after model artifact is present.

deploy-bot: rollout started: `keda/tenant-abc scaledobject updated (minReplicaCount 0->1)` by kevin at 09:36 UTC.

ops-bot: Alert: proxy 5xx rate back to baseline at 09:48 UTC after scaling change.

maria: Postmortem notes (brief): primary chain — spot preemptions + minReplicaCount=0 + heavy init pulls -> scheduling + readiness delays -> increased queue backlog -> gateway 502/504. Remediation: default minReplicaCount=1 for tenants with >50rps baseline, implement lazy artifact fetch + shared cache, introduce a readiness grace window to avoid routing during init.

kevin: Action items:
- kevin: rollout minReplicaCount=1 for affected tenants (done for tenant-abc)
- raj: investigate node startup taint timing and reduce label/taint apply latency (ETA 24h)
- maria: document support repro steps and add customer guidance (ETA 6h)
- lina: add automated smoke check to validate prewarm during deploys (ETA 48h)

lina: Marking incident resolved for now; will track follow-ups in the backlog. :white_check_mark:
